title: Wings live: Gaumont Theatre, Southampton | 1979
content:
Wings performed at the Gaumont Theatre in Southampton, England, on 1 December 1979.

It was the seventh night of the 19-date Wings UK Tour 1979.

The band had previously performed at the Gaumont on 9 September 1975. The Beatles had performed there on 20 May and 13 December 1963, and 6 November 1964.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Laurence Juber on guitar; and Steve Holley on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.
